tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while holding {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB}, you can create one item in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of yourself, choosing the item from the following list:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 作為持有{@item 修補工具|XPHB}時的一個{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作，你可以在自身5尺內的一個未佔據空間中創造一個物品，從以下列表中選擇該物品：

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you regain all expended uses of your {@classFeature Flash of Genius|Artificer|EFA|7|EFA} if you have {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to at least one magic item.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你完成一次{@variantrule 短休|XPHB}時，如果你與至少一件魔法物品{@variantrule 同調|XPHB}，你恢復所有已消耗的{@classFeature 靈光一閃|奇械師|EFA|7|EFA}使用次數。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As an artificer, you use tools when you cast your spells. When describing your spellcasting, think about how you're using a tool to perform the spell effect. If you cast {@spell cure wounds} using {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB}, you could be quickly producing a salve. If you cast it using {@item tinker's tools|PHB}, you might have a miniature mechanical spider that binds wounds. When you cast {@spell poison spray}, you could fling foul chemicals or use a wand that spits venom. The effect of the spell is the same as for a spellcaster of any other class, but your method of spellcasting is special.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 身為一名奇械師，你使用工具來施法。當描述你的施法時，請想想你是如何使用這個工具的。比方說，如果你使用{@item 鍊金工具|PHB}來施展{@spell 療傷術}，你可以很快的製造出一份藥膏。如果你用{@item 修補工具|PHB}來施展，你可能會拿出一個微型機械蜘蛛來縫合傷口。當你施放{@spell 毒氣噴湧}時，你可以噴射出有毒的化學物質，或者使用一根噴射毒液的魔杖。雖然法術的效果與其他的施法者職業沒有區別。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while holding {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB}, you can use that tool to magically produce two elixirs. For each elixir, roll on the Experimental Elixir table for the elixir's effect, which is triggered when someone drinks the elixir. The elixir appears in a vial, and the vial vanishes when the elixir is drunk or poured out. If any elixir remains when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, the elixir and its vial vanish.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每當你持有{@item 鍊金工具|XPHB}完成一次{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}時，你可以使用該工具魔法般地製造兩瓶靈藥。對於每瓶靈藥，在實驗性靈藥表格上擲骰以確定靈藥的效果，當有人飲用靈藥時觸發該效果。靈藥出現在一個小瓶中，當靈藥被飲用或倒出時小瓶消失。如果在你完成一次{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}時仍有任何靈藥剩餘，該靈藥及其小瓶都會消失。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while holding {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB}, you can expend one spell slot to create another elixir. When you do so, you choose its effect from the Experimental Elixir table rather than rolling.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 作為持有{@item 鍊金工具|XPHB}時的一個{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作，你可以消耗一個法術位來製造另一瓶靈藥。當你這樣做時，你可以從實驗性靈藥表格中選擇其效應而非隨機擲骰。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@b Healing.} The drinker regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d8} plus your Intelligence modifier. The number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} restored increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach Artificer levels 9 ({@dice 3d8}) and 15 ({@dice 4d8}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@b 治療。} 飲用者恢復等於 {@dice 2d8} 加上你的智力調整值的 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}。當你達到奇械師等級9（{@dice 3d8}）和15（{@dice 4d8}）時，恢復的 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} 數值增加 {@dice 1d8}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid damage and Poison damage. You also gain {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你獲得對強酸傷害和毒素傷害的{@variantrule 抗性|XPHB}。你還獲得對{@condition 中毒|XPHB}狀態的{@variantrule 免疫|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while you have {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB} in hand, you can turn a suit of armor you are wearing into Arcane Armor. The armor continues to be Arcane Armor until you don another suit of armor or you die.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你手上有{@item 鐵匠工具|XPHB}時，你可以用一個{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作將你穿著的一套盔甲轉變為奧能裝甲。該盔甲會保持為奧能裝甲，直到你裝著另一套盔甲或你死亡為止。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks. If the armor imposes {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on such checks, the {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} and {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} cancel each other, as normal.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你在敏捷（{@skill 隱匿|XPHB}）檢定上具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。如果該護甲對此類檢定施加{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}，則{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}和{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}相互抵消，如常。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You and your allies have {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} while within 10 feet of your {@object Eldritch Cannon|EFA}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你和你的盟友在你的{@object 魔能炮臺|EFA}10尺內擁有{@variantrule 掩護|XPHB|半身掩護}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In combat, the defender acts during your turn. It can move and take its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} on its own, but the only action it takes is the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action unless you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to command it to take an action. If you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, the defender acts on its own and isn't limited to the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在戰鬥中，防禦者會在你的回合行動。它可以自行移動和使用{@variantrule 反應|XPHB}，但除非你使用{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}命令它執行一個動作，否則它只能執行{@action 迴避|XPHB}動作。如果你處於{@condition 失能|XPHB}狀態，防禦者會自行行動且不受限於{@action 迴避|XPHB}動作。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can create a new {@creature Steel Defender|EFA|defender} if you have {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB} in hand. If you already have a defender from this feature, the first one vanishes.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每當你完成一次{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}，如果你手中有{@item 鐵匠工具|XPHB}，就可以建立一個新的{@creature 鋼鐵守衛|EFA|防禦者}。如果你已經透過此特性擁有一個防禦者，則第一個防禦者會消失。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} while holding {@item Cartographer's Tools|XPHB}, you can use that tool to create a set of magical maps by touching at least two creatures (one of whom can be yourself), up to a maximum number of creatures equal to 1 plus your Intelligence modifier (minimum of two creatures). Each target receives a magical map, which constantly updates to show the relative position of all the map holders but is illegible to all others. The maps last until you die or until you use this feature again, at which point any existing maps created by this feature immediately vanish.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每當你持用{@item 製圖工具|XPHB}完成一次{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}時，你可以使用該工具透過接觸至少兩個生物（其中一個可以是你自己）來建立一套魔法地圖，最多生物數量等於1加上你的智力調整值（最少兩個生物）。每個目標獲得一張魔法地圖，該地圖會不斷更新以顯示所有地圖持有者的相對位置，但對所有其他人來說都是無法辨認的。這些地圖持續到你死亡或你再次使用此特性為止，此時任何由該特性建立的現有地圖會立即消失。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The target adds {@dice 1d4} to its {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 目標在其{@variantrule 先攻|XPHB}檢定上增加{@dice 1d4}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you scribe a {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG} using the crafting rules in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, the amount of time required to craft it is halved.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你使用{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中的手作規則來抄寫{@item 法術卷軸|XDMG}時，製造它所需的時間減半。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In addition, taking damage can't cause you to lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} on {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 此外，受到傷害不會使你失去對{@spell 妖火|XPHB}的{@status 專注|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Using {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB} or another type of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} with which you have proficiency, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a {@creature Reanimated Companion|RHW} through the power of necromancy and science. The companion manifests in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. You determine the companion's appearance; your choices don't affect the companion's game statistics.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你能夠以一個{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作，使用{@item 修補工具|XPHB}或你具有熟練的其他種類的工匠工具，透過亡靈法術與科學的力量創造一名{@creature 再起伴兵|RHW}（資料卡見下）。伴兵顯現於你5尺的未佔據空間中。伴兵的外觀由你決定，但你的選擇不會改變其遊戲資料。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The companion is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your allies and obeys you. It lasts until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} or until you take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to dismiss it early, at which point it harmlessly collapses into a pile of viscera. It immediately drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and dies (triggering its Death Burst trait) if you die.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 伴兵對你和你的盟友態度{@variantrule 友好【態度】|XPHB|友好}並服從於你。伴兵存在持續至你完成長休，或在你執行魔法動作令其解散時提前結束。此時伴兵無害地坍塌為一堆內臟。若你死亡，則伴兵立即降至0生命值並死亡（觸發其自爆特質）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Once you create a companion, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} or expend a spell slot to create one. You can have only one companion at a time and can't create one while your companion is present.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一旦你創造了一名伴兵，你無法再次創造伴兵直至你完成長休或你消耗一個法術位來創造伴兵。你同時只能擁有一名伴兵，伴兵存在期間你無法創造伴兵。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In combat, the companion acts during your turn. It can move and take its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} on its own, but the only action it takes is the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action unless you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to command it to take an action. If you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, the companion acts on its own and isn't limited to the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在戰鬥中，伴兵在你的回合內行動。其可以移動並自行執行反應，但除非你以附贈動作命令其執行動作，否則其唯一可用的動作是{@action 迴避|XPHB}動作。若你陷入{@condition 失能|XPHB}狀態，則伴兵會自行行動且不再限制於迴避動作。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you cast {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB}, you can modify the spell so that it sends a jolt of electricity through the target, reviving it. The target regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Artificer level, and each creature of your choice in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the target makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 2d4} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你施展{@spell 維生術|XPHB}時，可以修改此法術使其向目標發射一陣電流，令其回生。目標恢復等於你奇械師等級的生命值，且位於源自其10尺{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}區域內的每名你選擇的生物必須進行一次對抗你法術豁免DC的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到{@damage 2d4}閃電傷害，豁免成功則受到一半傷害。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can modify the spell this way a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. The Lightning damage of this feature increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach Artificer levels 11 ({@dice 3d4}) and 17 ({@dice 4d4}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你能夠以此法修改法術的次數等於你的智力調整值。你在完成長休時重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。此特性的閃電傷害在你的奇械師等級達到11級（{@dice 3d4}）和17級（{@dice 4d4}）時提高{@dice 1d4}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You gain proficiency with {@item Alchemist's Supplies|XPHB}. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} of your choice.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你獲得{@item 鍊金工具|XPHB}的熟練。若你已經擁有其熟練，則你獲得另一種你選擇的工匠工具的熟練。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The damage of your {@creature Reanimated Companion|RHW|Reanimated Companion's} Death Burst increases to {@dice 4d4}. Necrotic damage dealt by your companion ignores {@spell Resistance|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你{@creature 再起伴兵|RHW|復生同伴的}的自爆傷害增加至{@dice 4d4}。你伴兵造成的暗蝕傷害無視抗性。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The companion's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases to 45 feet, and it gains a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. It can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. In addition, whenever a creature of your choice starts its turn within a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from your companion, the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 伴兵的速度提升至45尺，且其獲得等於其速度的攀爬速度。伴兵可以在難以攀爬的表面上攀爬，包括沿著天花板移動，且無需為此進行屬性檢定。此外，每當一名你選擇的生物在源自你伴兵的10尺{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}區域內開始其回合時，該生物必須成功透過一次對抗你法術豁免DC的感知豁免，否則陷入{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態直至其下個回合開始。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The companion gains a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so. In addition, whenever the companion is hit by an attack roll from a creature within 10 feet of itself, the attacker takes Acid damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 伴兵獲得等於其速度的游泳速度，且其可以移動穿過最窄1寸寬的空間而無需額外消耗移動力。此外，每當伴兵被位於其10尺內生物的一次攻擊檢定命中時，攻擊者受到等於你智力調整值的強酸傷害。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can cast {@spell Raise Dead|XPHB} once without expending a spell slot and without Material components, provided you use {@item Tinker's Tools|XPHB} or another type of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} with which you have proficiency as the {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 只要你使用{@item 修補工具|XPHB}或你具有熟練的其他種類的工匠工具作為施法法器，你便可以無需材料成分且無需法術位地施展一次{@spell 死者復活|XPHB}。此特性一經使用，直到你完成長休都無法再次使用。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can siphon the animating magic of your {@creature Reanimated Companion|RHW} to bolster yourself. When you or your companion takes damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to gain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your companion's current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The companion then immediately drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and dies (triggering its Death Burst trait).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你可以汲取你{@creature 再起伴兵|RHW}體內的活化魔法以強化自身。當你或你的伴兵受到傷害時，你能夠以反應恢復等於你伴兵當前生命值的生命值。伴兵隨後立即降至0生命值並死亡（觸發其自爆特質）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Creating an {@i experimental elixir} requires you to have {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB} on your person, and any elixir you create with this feature lasts until it is drunk or until the end of your next long rest.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你必須要擁有{@item 鍊金工具|PHB}才能製造{@i 實驗性靈藥}，你透過此特性創造的任何靈藥會一直存在，直到被飲用、或是你的下一次長休結束時。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can cast {@spell greater restoration} and {@spell heal} without expending a spell slot, without preparing the spell, and without material components, provided you use {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB} as the spellcasting focus. Once you cast either spell with this feature, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 只要你使用{@item 鍊金工具|PHB}作為你的法器，就能夠在不消費法術位、不需要準備、不需要材料成分的情況下施展{@spell 高等復原術}與{@spell 醫療術}。一旦你透過此特性施展這些法術中的一個，你就不能再以這種方式施展那個法術，直到你完成一次長休。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your steel defender gains a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你的鋼鐵守衛AC獲得+2加值。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You gain an uncanny sense of when things aren't as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge perils. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當非常事態發生時，一種不可思議的感覺降臨你的心頭，指引你更好的躲避危機。只要你未陷入{@condition 失能|XPHB}狀態，你的敏捷豁免檢定就具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions while your Rage is active. If you're {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} when you enter your Rage, the condition ends on you.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 狂暴啟用期間，你具有{@condition 魅惑|XPHB}與{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態的{@variantrule 免疫|XPHB}。當你進入狂暴時，若你已陷入{@condition 魅惑|XPHB}或{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}，你陷入的這些狀態立即結束。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you activate your Rage, you can take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} and {@action Dash|XPHB} actions as part of that {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While your Rage is active, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to take both of those actions.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你啟用狂暴時，作為你進入狂暴的{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}的一部分，你可以同時執行{@action 撤離|XPHB}與{@action 疾走|XPHB}動作。狂暴啟用期間，你也能夠以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}同時執行這兩個動作。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to give a creature a Bardic Inspiration die, you can have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition and teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see as part of that {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. This invisibility lasts until the start of your next turn and ends early immediately after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}給予一名生物吟遊詩人激勵骰時，作為此{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}的一部分，你能夠獲得{@condition 隱形|XPHB}狀態並傳送至30尺內你能夠看見的未被佔據的空間。隱形狀態會持續至你的下回合開始，或在你進行一次攻擊檢定、造成傷害或施展法術時立即終止。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You employ tools that aid you in channeling spirits. You gain a Gaming Set ({@item playing cards|XPHB}). You have proficiency with this Gaming Set, and you can use it or one of the following items as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Bard spells: {@item Arcane Focus|XPHB} ({@item crystal|XPHB} or {@item orb|XPHB}), {@item Candle|XPHB}, or {@item Ink Pen|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你使用工具幫助你與精魂溝通。你獲得一副賭具（{@item 紙牌|XPHB}）。你擁有此賭具的熟練，並且你可以使用這副牌或以下列舉物品中的任意一個作為你吟遊詩人法術的施法法器來使用：奧術法器（{@item 水晶|XPHB}或{@item 法球|XPHB}），{@item 蠟燭|XPHB}，或者{@item 墨水筆|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can call forth spirits of the dead to empower you and your allies. When you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to give a creature a Bardic Inspiration die, you can call forth the powers of a random spirit. To determine the spirit you channel, roll the Bardic Inspiration die and refer to the Spirits from Beyond table. The spirit remains channeled until you unleash it or until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你可以呼喚亡者的精魂，以此增強你和你的盟友。當你使用附贈動作給予一個生物吟遊詩人激勵骰時，你可以喚起一種隨機精魂的力量。擲出該吟遊詩人激勵骰並參照彼岸之魂表以決定是什麼精魂與你通靈。直至你釋放精魂，或完成了一次短休或長休前，該精魂會持續與你通靈。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration and channel a specific spirit. When you do so, choose the spirit from the Spirits from Beyond table rather than rolling. The chosen spirit's corresponding number must be less than or equal to the highest number on your Bardic Inspiration die; for example, if your Bardic Inspiration die is a {@dice d8}, you can choose to channel any spirit up to (and including) the Shade.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你可以使用附贈動作並消耗一次吟遊詩人激勵的使用次數，以此通靈一位特定的精魂。當你如此做時，你直接從彼岸之魂表上選擇精魂，而無需擲骰。所選精魂的對應序號必須等於或小於你當前吟遊詩人激勵骰的最大面值；例如，如果你的吟遊詩人激勵骰是{@dice d8}，你可以選擇通靈直至幽靈（序號8）在內的任何精魂。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Beloved. The target regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die plus your Charisma modifier.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 心上人（Beloved）。目標恢復等於你的一個吟遊詩人激勵骰骰值外加你的魅力調整值的生命值。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Renegade. The target can immediately take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 叛逆者（Renegade）。目標立即執行其反應傳送至30尺範圍內一處其可見的未佔據空間。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Wayfarer. The target gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die plus your Bard level. While the target has these Temporary Hit Points, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 尋路人（Wayfarer）。目標獲得等同於你的一個吟遊詩人激勵骰骰值外加你的吟遊詩人等級的{@variantrule 臨時生命值|XPHB}，當目標擁有這些臨時生命值時，它的速度增加10尺。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Coward. The target and each creature of your choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. While a creature is Frightened, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved (round down), and it can take either an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, not both.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 懦夫（Coward）。目標和源自目標的30尺{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}內你所選擇的每個生物都必須進行一次感知豁免，豁免失敗則陷入{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態，直至你的下一回合開始。恐慌期間，該生物的速度減半（向下取整），且只能執行一個動作，或是一個附贈動作，而不能同時執行兩者。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Priest. The target regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to two rolls of your Bardic Inspiration die, and one of the following conditions of your choice ends on the target: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, or {@condition Stunned|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 祭司（Priest）。目標恢復等同於兩次吟遊詩人激勵骰骰值的生命值，並且你可以選擇解除目標的以下一種狀態：{@condition 目盲|XPHB}、{@condition 魅惑|XPHB}、{@condition 耳聾|XPHB}、{@condition 麻痺|XPHB}、{@condition 中毒|XPHB}或{@condition 震懾|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Once per turn, when you cast a Bard spell with a spell slot that deals damage or restores {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, roll {@dice 1d6}. You gain a bonus equal to the number rolled to one of the spell's damage rolls or to the total {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} the spell restores.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每回合一次，當你使用法術位施展一道造成傷害或恢復生命值的吟遊詩人法術時，擲一個{@dice 1d6}。該次法術的其中一次傷害擲骰，或是該法術恢復的生命值總和，將獲得等同於你擲骰結果的數值加值。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Whenever you cast the spell, you can modify it so the spirits also guard against worldly threats. When you cast the spell in this way, you and allies within the spell's {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@table Cover|XPHB|Half Cover}. Once you modify the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每當你施展該法術時，你可以修改它，使得靈體能夠抵禦世間的威脅。以此種方式施展該法術時，在靈體的{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}內，你和你的盟友獲得{@table 掩護|XPHB|半身掩護}。一旦你以此種方式修改了該法術，直至你進行一次短休或長休前你都無法再這麼做。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) check you make that involves you dancing.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你進行的任何有關舞蹈的魅力（{@skill 表演|XPHB}）檢定均具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you cast {@spell Command|XPHB} without expending a spell slot, and you take on an unearthly appearance for 1 minute or until your {@status Concentration|XPHB} ends. During this time, you can cast {@spell Command|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} without expending a spell slot.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}，你無需法術位地施展{@spell 命令術|XPHB}，然後你將獲得超凡脫俗的容貌，持續 1 分鐘或在你{@status 專注|XPHB}終止時提前結束。在此期間，你能夠以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}，無需法術位地施展法術{@spell 命令術|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In addition, you can use a Simple or Martial weapon as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} to cast spells from your {@filter Bard spell list|spells|class=Bard}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 此外，你施展你的{@filter 吟遊詩人法術列表|spells|class=吟遊詩人}中的法術時，可以使用簡易或軍用武器作為{@variantrule 法器|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature that's missing any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by casting a spell or by hitting with an attack roll, that creature takes an extra {@damage 1d4} Necrotic damage. This extra damage increases to {@dice 1d6} when you reach Cleric level 11.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每回合一次，當你對一個生命值未滿的生物透過施展了一道法術或以一次攻擊檢定命中造成傷害時，該生物額外受到{@damage 1d4}暗蝕傷害。當你到達牧師等級11級時，此額外傷害增加至{@dice 1d6}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can cast {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你可以使用附贈動作施展{@spell 維生術|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Additionally, when you would normally roll one or more dice to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} with a spell or Channel Divinity, don't roll those dice for the healing; instead, use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring {@dice 2d4} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} with a spell, you restore 8.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 此外，當你用法術或引導神力投擲一枚或多枚骰子用於恢復生命值為0的生物的生命時，你不用為治療投擲這些骰子；改為使用每個骰子的最大值。例如，你用法術為生命值為0的生物恢復{@dice 2d4}生命值時，改為恢復8點。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you or a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself is hit with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to halve that attack's damage (round down). If the triggering attack roll was a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, any effects triggered by a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} are canceled.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你或你60尺範圍內你可見的一個{@status 浴血|XPHB}生物被一次攻擊檢定命中時，你可以執行一個反應並減半該攻擊的傷害（向下取整）。如果觸發的攻擊為一次重擊，一切重擊觸發的效應都被取消。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你可以使用此特性的次數等同於你的感知調整值次（至少1次），在你完成一次長休後你重獲全部已被消耗的使用次數。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When an enemy dies within 60 feet of you, you or one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your Cleric level. You can't use this feature if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, unless you expend a level 6+ spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of it.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當一個敵人在你60尺內死亡時，你或你60尺範圍內你可見的一個生物恢復等同於你牧師等級兩倍的生命值。你不能在{@condition 失能|XPHB}狀態下使用此特性。一旦你使用了此特性，直到你完成一次短休或長休或直到你消耗一個6環及以上的法術位（無需動作）來恢復你的使用次數，你都不能再次使用它。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature, that creature regains additional {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} on the turn you cast the spell. The additional {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你消耗法術位施展法術的回合中，當該法術恢復生物的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}時，額外恢復 2 + 消耗法術位環階{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you present your {@item Holy Symbol|XPHB} and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to evoke healing energy that can restore a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to five times your Cleric level. Choose {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creatures within 30 feet of yourself (which can include you), and divide those {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 以一個{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作，你展示{@item 聖徽|XPHB}並消耗一次引導神力來引導治療能量恢復等於你牧師等級五倍的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}。你選擇身邊 30 尺內處於{@status 浴血|XPHB}狀態的生物作為此特性的目標（可以包括你），再為其分配從中獲得的治療能量。該特性至多將目標的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}恢復至其上限的一半。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, don't roll those dice for the healing; instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring {@dice 2d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature with a spell, you restore 12.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你需要用一道法術或引導神力擲一枚或多枚骰子，以決定為一個生物恢復的生命數值時，你無需擲骰，直接為每個骰子取最高值。例如，一道法術為某一生物恢復{@dice 2d6}{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}，則其結果直接取 12。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In addition, whenever you use Warding Flare, you can give the target of the triggering attack a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d6} plus your Wisdom modifier.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 此外，每當你使用守禦之光時，你可以給予觸發此反應的該次攻擊所指定那個目標{@dice 2d6} + 你感知調整值點{@variantrule 臨時生命值|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can choose yourself or a willing creature within 30 feet of yourself to have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks. This blessing lasts until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} or you use this feature again.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 以一個{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作，你可以選擇自己或 30 尺內一個自願生物，所選生物在進行敏捷（{@skill 隱匿|XPHB}）檢定時具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。此祝福持續至你完成一次{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}或直至你再次使用此特性。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A constellation of a life-giving goblet appears on you. Whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature, you or another creature within 30 feet of you can regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your Wisdom modifier.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個予命聖盃的星座於你身上浮現。當你消耗法術位施展一個為生物恢復{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}的法術時，你或你周圍 30 尺內的另一生物可以恢復等同於 {@dice 1d8} + 你的感知調整值點的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your training with weapons allows you to use the {@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|mastery properties} of three kinds of {@filter Simple|items|type=simple weapon} or {@filter Martial|items|type=martial weapon} weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你對武器的訓練使你能夠運用三種自選的{@filter 簡易|items|type=簡易武器}或{@filter 軍用|items|type=軍用武器}的{@variantrule 武器精通詞條|XPHB|精通詞條}。每當你完成一次{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}時，你可以重新演練武器技巧，來改變你所選擇的其中一個武器型別。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You have a mind for tactics on and off the battlefield. When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to push yourself toward success. Rather than regaining {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you roll {@dice 1d10} and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. If the check still fails, this use of Second Wind isn't expended.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在戰場內外，你都能夠運用你的戰術思維。當你在一次屬性檢定上失敗時，你可以消耗一次回氣次數讓你更接近成功。你擲{@dice 1d10}並將骰值加入到結果之中，而非恢復{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}。這可能會讓結果變為成功。如果檢定依舊失敗，則不會消耗回氣次數。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you use your Second Wind to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can choose a number of allies within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from yourself, up to a number of allies equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Each of those allies regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d4} plus your Fighter level. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你使用你的回氣特性來回復{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}時，你可以選擇等同於你魅力調整值數量（最少為1）的，在以你自身為源點30尺{@variantrule 光環 [效應區域]|XPHB|光環}區域內的盟友。每個盟友獲得等同於{@dice 1d4}+你的戰士等級的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}回覆。每當你使用此能力後，直至你完成一次{@variantrule 短休|XPHB|短}或{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}前無法再次使用。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can now score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 18–20 on the {@dice d20}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你使用武器或徒手打擊進行的攻擊檢定在{@dice d20}中擲出 18-20 時即可造成{@variantrule 重擊|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: At the start of each of your turns, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB} and have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你的回合開始時，若你已{@status 浴血|XPHB}且擁有至少 1 點{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值}，你恢復等同於5加上你的體質調整值的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Alternatively, you can expend 1 Focus Point to take both the {@action Disengage|XPHB} and the {@action Dodge|XPHB} actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你能以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}執行{@action 撤離|XPHB}動作。此外，你可以消耗 1 點功力，以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}同時執行{@action 迴避|XPHB}與{@action 撤離|XPHB}動作。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Alternatively, you can expend 1 Focus Point to take both the {@action Disengage|XPHB} and {@action Dash|XPHB} actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你能以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}執行{@action 疾走|XPHB}動作。此外，你可以消耗 1 點功力，以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}同時執行{@action 撤離|XPHB}與{@action 疾走|XPHB}動作，同時使你該回合內的跳躍距離翻倍。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You gain {@sense blindsight} out to 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}, even if you're {@condition blinded} or in darkness. Moreover, you can see an {@condition invisible} creature within that range, unless the creature successfully hides from you.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你獲得10尺{@sense 盲視}。在盲視範圍內，即使你{@condition 目盲}或處於黑暗中，你仍可以清晰地看到任何不處於{@quickref 掩護||3||全身掩護}的事物。而且，你可以在盲視範圍內看到{@condition 隱形}生物，除非此生物對你躲藏成功。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your mastery of life energy opens the door to the ultimate mercy. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can touch the corpse of a creature that died within the past 24 hours and expend 5 Focus Points. The creature then returns to life with a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 4d10} plus your Wisdom modifier. If the creature died with any of the following conditions, the creature revives with the conditions removed: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, and {@condition Stunned|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你對生命能量的掌握開啟了通往命流奧義的大門。以一個{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作，你可以消耗 5 點功力並觸碰一名死亡不超過 24 小時的生物的屍體。該生物會起死回生，以等於{@dice 4d10} + 你的感知調整值的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}復活。如果該生物死前具有任意以下狀態，該生物復活時這些狀態被移除：{@condition 目盲|XPHB}、{@condition 耳聾|XPHB}、{@condition 麻痺|XPHB}、{@condition 中毒|XPHB}和{@condition 震懾|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while entirely within {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, you can expend 3 Focus Points to shroud yourself with shadows for 1 minute, until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or until you end your turn in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}. While shrouded by these shadows, you gain the following benefits.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你完全身處{@variantrule 微光光照|XPHB}或{@variantrule 黑暗|XPHB}環境下時，你能夠以一個{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作消耗3點功力來讓你周圍環繞幽影，持續 1 分鐘，直至你陷入{@condition 失能|XPHB}狀態或在{@variantrule 明亮光照|XPHB}中結束回合。當週身環繞幽影時，你獲得以下好處：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Concentrating on a discipline follows the same rules as {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell. This rule means you can't concentrate on a spell and a discipline at the same time, nor can you concentrate on two disciplines at the same time. See {@book chapter 10|PHB|10}, "Spellcasting," in the Player's Handbook for how {@status concentration} works.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 專注於一項靈術遵循與{@status 專注||專注於}法術相同的規則。這意味著你無法同時專注於一個法術和一項靈術，也無法同時專注於兩項靈術。關於{@status 專注}如何運作，請參閱《玩家手冊》{@book 第十章|PHB|10}"施法"章節。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your training with weapons allows you to use the {@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|mastery properties} of two kinds of {@filter weapons|items|type=simple weapon;martial weapon} of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as {@item Longsword|XPHB|Longswords} and {@item Javelin|XPHB|Javelins}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你對武器的訓練使你能夠運用兩種自選的你具有熟練的{@filter 武器|items|type=簡易武器;軍用武器}的{@variantrule 武器精通詞條|XPHB|精通詞條}，例如{@item 長劍|XPHB|長劍}和{@item 標槍|XPHB|標槍}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You and your allies have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a {@condition Frightened|XPHB} ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你與守護靈光內盟友獲得對{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態的{@variantrule 免疫|XPHB}。陷入{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}的盟友進入靈光時，該狀態在靈光內會暫時無效。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You emanate an aura of menace in a 30-foot radius. The first time any enemy creature enters the aura or starts its turn there during a battle, the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. {@action Attack} rolls against the {@condition frightened} creature have advantage.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你散發出一個30尺半徑範圍的威脅靈光。在一次戰鬥中，任何敵對生物第一次進入靈光範圍，或者在靈光範圍內開始其回合時，都必須進行一次感知豁免。豁免失敗者將在接下來的1分鐘陷入對你的{@condition 恐慌}狀態，直至受到傷害。對因此陷入 {@condition 恐慌}的生物所進行的任何{@action 攻擊} 檢定都具有優勢。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Starting at 15th level, a holy presence mends your wounds in battle. You regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d6} + half your paladin level if you end your turn in combat with fewer than half of your hit points remaining and you aren't {@condition incapacitated}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 從15級起，神聖之儀將在你的戰鬥中為你補愈傷痕。只要你未處於{@condition 失能}狀態，若你在戰鬥中結束你的回合時，若剩餘的生命值少於最大生命值的一半，則你恢復{@dice 1d6}+你聖武士等級一半 點的生命值。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You and your allies have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a {@condition Charmed|XPHB} ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你與位於你守護靈光內的盟友具有{@condition 魅惑|XPHB}{@variantrule 免疫|XPHB}。陷入{@condition 魅惑|XPHB}的盟友進入靈光時，該狀態在靈光內會暫時無效。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to augment your athleticism. For 1 hour, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) and Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks, and the distance of your Long and High Jumps increases by 10 feet (this extra distance costs movement as normal).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}，你可以消耗一次引導神力次數以增強運動能力。1 小時內，你在力量（{@skill 運動|XPHB}）檢定和敏捷（{@skill 特技|XPHB}）檢定上獲得{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}，且你跳遠和跳高的距離增加 10 尺（你依然為此正常消耗移動力）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Whenever an enemy starts its turn in your Aura of Protection, that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. {@action Attack|XPHB} rolls against the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creature have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每個在靈光範圍內開始其回合的敵人，必須成功透過一個感知豁免，否則將陷入{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態 1 分鐘，或直到其受到傷害。此外，對被{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}生物發動的{@action 攻擊|XPHB}檢定具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your training with weapons allows you to use the {@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|mastery properties} of two kinds of {@filter weapons|items|type=simple weapon;martial weapon} of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as {@item Longbow|XPHB|Longbows} and {@item Shortsword|XPHB|Shortswords}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你對武器的訓練使你能夠自選並使用2種已熟練{@filter 武器|items|type=簡易武器;軍用武器}的{@variantrule 武器精通詞條|XPHB|精通詞條}，例如{@item 長弓|XPHB|長弓}和{@item 短劍|XPHB|短劍}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can give yourself a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). You can use this action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 以一個{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作，你能夠給予自己{@dice 1d8} + 你的感知調整值（最低為 1） 的{@variantrule 臨時生命值|XPHB}。你能夠使用此特性的次數等於你的感知調整值次（最少 1 次），當你完成一次{@variantrule 長休|XPHB}時，你重獲全部已消耗的使用次數。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You are also adept at evading creatures that rely on {@sense darkvision}. While in darkness, you are {@condition invisible} to any creature that relies on {@sense darkvision} to see you in that darkness.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你還擅長迴避依賴{@sense 黑暗視覺}的生物。在黑暗中，你對於任何依靠{@sense 黑暗視覺}觀察你的生物而言視為{@condition 隱形}的生物。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Ice rimes you and your prey, protecting you and slowing them. When you cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your {@class Ranger|XPHB} level.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 冰霜會覆蓋你和你的獵物，保護你並讓你的獵物變得遲緩。當你施展{@spell 獵人印記|XPHB}法術時，你獲得等同於{@dice 1d10}+你{@class 遊俠|XPHB}等級的{@variantrule 臨時生命值|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your experience surviving harrowing environments allows you to bolster your allies in addition to yourself. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, choose a number of creatures you can see equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one). Each chosen creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Ranger level and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你在酷烈環境中生存的經驗不僅足夠支撐你自己，也能幫助你的盟友。以一個{@action 魔法|XPHB}動作，你可以選擇等同於你感知調整值（至少1個）數量的可見生物。所選的生物能夠恢復等同於 {@dice 1d10}+你的遊俠等級點的{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}，且接下來的1小時內，其為避免或結束{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態所進行的豁免具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You draw power from the strange and ancient horrors of the land, causing you to sprout unnatural growths, such as bloody antlers or putrid fangs, or causing your shadow to lengthen or twist around you. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a use of Favored {@variantrule Enemy|XPHB} to transform into a ghastly form, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute or until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, die, or end the transformation (no action required).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你汲取這片土地上古老而奇詭的恐怖力量，令你的身體上長出不自然之物，例如滴血的鹿角或腐臭的獠牙，或者令你身後的陰影被拉長並扭曲著纏繞全身。你可以執行附贈動作消耗一次宿敵特性的使用次數來變身為駭人形態。該形態持續1分鐘，或直至你陷入{@condition 失能|XPHB}狀態、死亡，亦或是主動結束變身（無需動作）。變身期間，你獲得以下增益：

tagShapeMismatches.english: In addition, once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll while you are transformed using Wrath of the Wild, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Wisdom modifier, provided you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB} when you hit.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 此外，每回合一次，當你處於荒野之怒變身下並以攻擊檢定命中一個生物時，若你在命中目標時處於{@status 浴血|XPHB}，則你恢復等於{@dice 1d10}+你感知調整值的生命值。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When a creature fails its saving throw against your Unnerving Aura, it also can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} until the start of your next turn.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當一個生物在對抗你悚然靈光的豁免檢定中失敗時，直至你的下一回合開始，其還會無法恢復生命值，也無法執行反應。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If you're reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but not killed outright while transformed using Wrath of the Wild, you can surge with wild power. Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} instead change to a number equal to twice your Ranger level. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also expend a level 4+ spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of this feature.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你處於荒野之怒變身下，且生命值被降至0但未被立即殺死時，你可以使狂野之力噴薄而出。你的生命值改為變成等同於你遊俠等級兩倍的數值。該特性一經使用，則直至你完成一次長休前，都無法再次使用。你也可以消耗一枚四環或更高環階的法術位來恢復該特性的使用次數（無需動作）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} condition.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你免疫{@condition 力竭|XPHB}狀態。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In combat, the beast acts during your turn. It can move and use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} on its own, but the only action it takes is the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action unless you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to command it to take an action in its stat block or some other action. You can also sacrifice one of your attacks when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to command the beast to take the Beast's Strike action. If you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, the beast acts on its own and isn't limited to the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 戰鬥中，原初野獸會在你的回合中行動。它能自主地移動或使用{@variantrule 反應|XPHB}，但除非你在你的回合中以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}命令它執行其他動作，它只會執行{@action 迴避|XPHB}動作。命令的動作可以是其資料卡中列出的動作或是之外的其他動作。作為另一種命令方式，你也能在使用自己的{@action 攻擊|XPHB}動作時，犧牲一次自己的攻擊來命令野獸執行野獸打擊動作。如果你陷入{@condition 失能|XPHB}，野獸將會自主行動，而非僅使用{@action 迴避|XPHB}動作。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to command your Primal Companion beast to take an action, you can also command it to take the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Dodge|XPHB}, or {@action Help|XPHB} action using its {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你以{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}命令你的原初行侶野獸執行動作時，你還可以令它以它自己的{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}執行{@action 疾走|XPHB}、{@action 撤離|XPHB}、{@action 迴避|XPHB}或{@action 協助|XPHB}動作。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The magic of the Feywild guards your mind. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 妖精荒原的魔法護衛著你的心靈。你在對抗或終止{@condition 魅惑|XPHB}或{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態的豁免檢定上具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You are also adept at evading creatures that rely on {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}. While entirely in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition to any creature that relies on {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} to see you in that {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你還擅長避開依賴{@sense 黑暗視覺|XPHB}的角色。完全身處{@variantrule 黑暗|XPHB}期間，對於任何依靠{@sense 黑暗視覺|XPHB}觀察{@variantrule 黑暗|XPHB}中的你的生物而言，你具有{@condition 隱形|XPHB}狀態。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your tenacity can wear down even the most resilient foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d8} damage to the target if it's missing any of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你強而有力的攻擊可以擊倒最強壯的對手。當你用武器命中生物時，如果該敵人{@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}不滿，則該武器額外對目標造成{@damage 1d8}點傷害。你每回合只能造成一次這種額外傷害。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your training with weapons allows you to use the {@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|mastery properties} of two kinds of {@filter weapons|items|type=simple weapon;martial weapon} of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as {@item Dagger|XPHB|Daggers} and {@item Shortbow|XPHB|Shortbows}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你對武器的訓練使你能夠運用兩種自選的你具有熟練的{@filter 武器|items|type=簡易武器;軍用武器}的{@variantrule 武器精通詞條|XPHB|精通詞條}，例如{@item 匕首|XPHB|匕首}和{@item 短弓|XPHB|短弓}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You're so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand against you. No attack roll can have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} against you unless you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你飄忽不定的身形讓敵人攻擊時無從下手。只要你並未{@condition 失能|XPHB}，以你為目標的攻擊檢定無法具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You regain one expended use of {@subclassFeature Bloodthirst|Rogue|XPHB|Scion of the Three|FRHoF|3|FRHoF} when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每當你完成一次{@variantrule 短休|XPHB}，你恢復一次已消耗的{@subclassFeature 嗜血|遊蕩者|XPHB|三神門徒|FRHoF|3|FRHoF}特性使用次數。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你可以使用此特性的次數等同於你的敏捷調整值（至少1次），當你完成一次長休後你重獲所有已消耗的使用次數。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can choose one skill or tool proficiency that you lack and gain it, as a ghostly presence shares its knowledge with you. You lose this proficiency when you use this benefit again to choose a different proficiency.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每當你完成一次短休或長休時，你可以選擇一項你不具有熟練的技能或工具，某種幽靈般的存在會與你分享其生前學識，使你獲得該熟練。當你再次使用該增益選擇一項不同的熟練時，你會失去原來選擇的那項熟練。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You gain two soul trinkets. A soul trinket is a Tiny object (the DM determines the trinket's form or has you roll on the {@item Trinket|XPHB|Trinkets table} in the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB} to generate it). If you move more than 30 feet from a trinket, the trinket immediately teleports to you, appearing somewhere on your person.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你獲得兩件靈魂飾品；每個靈魂飾品都是一件微型的物件（由DM決定飾品的具體形態，或者你可以在{@book 玩家手冊|XPHB}中的{@item 飾品|XPHB|飾品表}來擲骰生成）。如果你距離某件你的靈魂飾品超過30尺，該飾品會立即傳送到你的身上某處出現。

tagShapeMismatches.english: While you have at least one soul trinket, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws} and Constitution saving throws.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 只要你還具有至少一件靈魂飾品，你進行的死亡豁免和體質豁免就具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you dies, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to gain another soul trinket, claiming a sliver of that creature's departing spirit. The new trinket appears somewhere on your person.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你30尺內你可見的一個生物死亡時，你可以用反應去攫取該生物離體靈魂的碎片，以獲得一個新的靈魂飾品。新的飾品會出現在你身上的某處。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} with fewer than two soul trinkets, you gain soul trinkets until you have two.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每當你完成長休時，若你擁有的靈魂飾品不足兩件，你將獲得靈魂飾品，直到擁有兩件為止。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you assume a spectral form, gaining the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you destroy one of your soul trinkets from Tokens of the Departed (no action required) to restore your use of it.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 作為一個附贈動作，你化為某種幽魂形態，並獲得以下增益，持續10分鐘，或直到你主動結束它們（無需動作）。一旦你使用了這一特性，直到完成一次長休前你都無法再次使用它，你也可以銷燬你的一件來自逝者遺物特性的靈魂飾品來重獲這一能力的使用權（無需動作）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 10 feet and can hover.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你獲得10尺飛行速度，並能懸浮。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you gain one soul trinket for your Tokens of the Departed if you have none remaining.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你投擲先攻時，若你的逝者遺物特性沒有剩餘的靈魂飾品，則你獲得一件靈魂飾品。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A random creature within 60 feet of you becomes {@condition poisoned} for {@dice 1d4} hours.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 距離你60尺內的一個隨機生物陷入持續{@dice 1d4}小時的{@condition 中毒}狀態。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You or one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d4} plus your Charisma modifier.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你或者一名你可見的30尺內的生物獲得等於{@dice 1d4}+你的魅力調整值的{@variantrule 臨時生命值|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your {@subclassFeature Spellfire Burst|Sorcerer|XPHB|Spellfire|FRHoF|3|FRHoF} improves. You add your {@class Sorcerer|XPHB} level to the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} gained from {@subclassFeature Bolstering Flames|Sorcerer|XPHB|Spellfire|FRHoF|3|FRHoF}, and the damage of {@subclassFeature Radiant Fire|Sorcerer|XPHB|Spellfire|FRHoF|3|FRHoF} increases to {@dice 1d8}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你的{@subclassFeature 咒火迸發|術士|XPHB|咒火|FRHoF|3|FRHoF}更加精進。{@subclassFeature 熾焰鼓舞|術士|XPHB|咒火|FRHoF|3|FRHoF}提供的{@variantrule 臨時生命值|XPHB}的數值現在獲得等同於你{@class 術士|XPHB}等級的加值，並且{@subclassFeature 輝耀之火|術士|XPHB|咒火|FRHoF|3|FRHoF}的傷害提升為{@dice 1d8}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If you would drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and not die outright, you can make a Charisma saving throw ({@dc 5} plus the damage taken). On a successful save, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} instead change to a number equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Sorcerer level. After you succeed on this save, you can't use this benefit again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 若你的生命值將要降至0且不會立即死亡，則你可以進行一次魅力豁免（{@dc 5}加上該次所受傷害）。若豁免成功，則你的生命值轉而變為等同於你的魅力調整值加上你的術士等級的數值。你成功於該豁免之後，直至你完成一次長休為止不可再次使用此增益。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can call forth a howling creature of shadow to hound your foes. You can spend 3 Sorcery Points to cast {@spell Summon Beast|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} without expending a spell slot, without preparing the spell, and without Material components. The summoned creature appears as a beast made of shadow, and enemies within 5 feet of the summoned creature have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells you cast.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你能夠驅使一頭嗥叫著的幽影生物追獵你的敵人。你可以消耗3點術法點，在無需準備該法術、無需材料成分、且不消耗法術位的情況下以一個附贈動作施展{@spell 野獸召喚術|XPHB}。被召喚出的生物呈現為由陰影構成的野獸。此外，任何位於該召喚生物5尺內的敵人在對抗你施展的法術時進行的豁免檢定均具有{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: While you are in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你處於{@variantrule 微光光照|XPHB}或{@variantrule 黑暗|XPHB}環境期間，你可以用一個附贈動作傳送至多120尺至另一處你可見的未佔據空間。以此法傳送至的目標空間必須同樣處於微光光照或黑暗中。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When you use Innate Sorcery, you can adopt a shadowy form, gaining the benefits below while your Innate Sorcery is active or until you end the form (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you spend 6 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你使用先天術法時，可以同時化作幽影之軀，以此在先天術法持續期間，或直到你主動結束此形態（無需動作）為止，獲得下述增益。此特性一經使用，直到你完成一次長休或使用6點術法點重置此特性的使用權為止不能再次使用。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage except Force and Radiant damage.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你具有除力場、光耀外所有傷害型別的抗性。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Psychic damage, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你獲得心靈傷害的{@variantrule 抗性|XPHB}。此外，你在避免和結束{@condition 魅惑|XPHB}狀態與{@condition 恐慌|XPHB}狀態的豁免檢定上具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Your connection to the plane of absolute order allows you to equalize chaotic moments. When a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself is about to roll a {@dice d20} with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to prevent the roll from being affected by {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} and {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你與絕對秩序之位面的聯絡使你能重整混沌的時刻。當你 60 尺內一個你可見的生物即將帶著{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}或是{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}進行一次{@dice d20}檢定時，你可以用{@variantrule 反應|XPHB}使這次檢定免受{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}或{@variantrule 劣勢|XPHB}的影響。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The spirits restore up to 100 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, divided as you choose among any number of creatures of your choice in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 精魂合計提供至多恢復 100 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}，由你隨意分配給範圍內任意數量的生物。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Any damaged objects entirely in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} are repaired instantly.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 範圍內損壞的物件將被立即修復。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Every spell of level 6 and lower ends on creatures and objects of your choice in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你選擇範圍內任意數量的生物或物件，其承受的任何六環或以下的法術結束。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You are subjected to an effect that lasts for 1 minute unless its description says otherwise. Roll {@dice 1d8} to determine the effect: on a 1, you're surrounded by faint, ethereal music only you and creatures within 5 feet of you can hear; on a 2, your size increases by one size category; on a 3, you grow a long beard made of feathers that remains until you sneeze, at which point the feathers explode from your face and vanish; on a 4, you must shout when you speak; on a 5, illusory butterflies flutter in the air within 10 feet of you; on a 6, an eye appears on your forehead, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks; on a 7, pink bubbles float out of your mouth whenever you speak; on an 8, your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue for 24 hours or until the effect is ended by a {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你獲得一個持續 1 分鐘（除非其描述另有說明）的效應。投擲{@dice 1d8}以決定效應：       骰值為 1，你被只有你和距你 5 尺內的生物才能聽到的空靈音樂聲環繞；骰值為 2，你的體型增大一級；骰值為 3，你臉上長出羽毛構成的絡腮鬍，一旦你打了噴嚏，這些羽毛會從你的臉上炸開並消失；骰值為 4，你說話時必須大聲喊叫；骰值為 5，距你 10 尺範圍內，會出現飛舞的虛幻蝴蝶；骰值為 6，你的前額長出第三隻眼，使你在感知（{@skill 察覺|XPHB}）檢定上獲得{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}；骰值為 7，你一說話就會吐出粉色的泡泡；    骰值為 8，你的皮膚透出藍色，持續 24 小時，法術{@spell 移除詛咒|XPHB}可結束此效應。

tagShapeMismatches.english: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you transform into an avatar of your patron's dreadful power, gaining the benefits below for 1 minute, until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or until you end the form (no action required). You can transform a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你可以使用附贈動作變身為你宗主那駭人偉力的化身。你獲得以下增益，持續1分鐘；當你陷入{@condition 失能|XPHB}狀態，或你主動結束該形態時（無需動作），該效應提前結束。你可以進行變身的次數等於你的魅力調整值（至少一次）。完成一次長休後，你恢復所有已消耗的使用次數。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Warlock level.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你獲得等於{@dice 1d10}加上你的魔契師等級的{@variantrule 臨時生命值|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Necrotic damage from your attacks, Warlock spells, and Warlock features ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage. Once per turn when you cast a spell that deals damage, you can change that spell's damage type to Necrotic.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 源自你的攻擊、魔契師法術以及魔契師特性的暗蝕傷害，無視暗蝕傷害抗性。每回合一次，當你施展一道造成傷害的法術時，你可以將該法術的傷害型別改為暗蝕傷害。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You don't gain {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels from {@hazard dehydration|XPHB}, {@hazard malnutrition|XPHB}, or {@hazard suffocation|XPHB}. In addition, you don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你不會因{@hazard 脫水|XPHB}、{@hazard 飢餓|XPHB}或{@hazard 窒息|XPHB}而獲得{@condition 力竭|XPHB}等級。此外，你無需睡眠，魔法也無法使你陷入睡眠。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage. While using your Form of Dread, you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你具有暗蝕傷害抗性。使用你的戰慄形態特性期間，你具有對暗蝕傷害的免疫。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 該增益一經使用，則直至你完成一次短休或長休前，都無法再次使用。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你具有鈍擊、穿刺和揮砍傷害抗性。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and can hover. You can move through creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, but you take {@damage 1d10} Force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你具有等於你速度的飛行速度，並且可以懸浮。你可以如同穿過{@variantrule 困難地形|XPHB}一般移動穿過生物或物件；但若你在你的回合結束時仍處於生物或物件內部，你受到{@damage 1d10}力場傷害。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can cast {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} in response to taking damage.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當你受到傷害時，你可以用{@variantrule 反應|XPHB}施展{@spell 迷蹤步|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You gain a bonus to your AC equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1), and your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet. In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你的AC獲得等同於你智力調整值的加值（最低+1），且你的{@variantrule 速度|XPHB}增加10尺。此外，你進行敏捷（{@skill 特技|XPHB}）檢定時具有{@variantrule 優勢|XPHB}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You always have the {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} and {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} spells prepared. In addition, you can cast {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, and you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to its ability check.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你始終準備著法術{@spell 法術反制|XPHB}和{@spell 解除魔法|XPHB}。此外，你能夠以一個{@variantrule 附贈動作|XPHB}施展{@spell 解除魔法|XPHB}，且你能在其屬性檢定中加入你的{@variantrule 熟練|XPHB|熟練加值}。
